scope: Syntactic candidates only: bindings, scope, control flow, rebinding and runtime search paths are not evaluated. Aliases are collected file-wide, including conditional and nested imports; a match may be shadowed or precede its binding. Only direct __import__, importlib.import_module, builtins.__import__ and explicit aliases of these are recognized. getattr, exec, wrapper functions and other loaders can be missed. Literal names are not evidence that a call runs or succeeds. Local candidates are exact source-name matches, not graph edges. No package discovery, source execution or environment reads occur.
collection_scope: Complete means collection finished within the stated budgets, not that runtime imports are known. Hidden and conventional dependency directories, symlinks and nonregular files are skipped. Explicit AST imports only; parse issues and dynamic calls remain visible. Use a stable source tree. These are input-size limits, not CPU, memory or elapsed-time guarantees.
